name: Merck
outlook:
What Merck says to expect

  • Full year 2026: salesThe Company now anticipates full-year 2026 sales to be between $66.8 billion and $67.3 billion, including a positive impact from foreign exchange of approximately 1% at mid-October 2026 exchange rates.
  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP EPSThe Company now expects full-year 2026 non-GAAP EPS to be between $2.77 and $2.82, including a positive impact from foreign exchange of approximately $0.15 per share at mid-October 2026 exchange rates.
  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP tax rateThe Company now expects the full-year non-GAAP effective income tax rate to be between 32.0% and 33.0%, including the impact of the non-tax-deductible one-time charges for the acquisitions of Cidara and Terns.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
